# Group-by-group readings (generated by scripts/reading.py)

Classify each cipher group of the yielding telegrams against an intended plaintext.
status per group and reader: R = reader's preferred letters give the word; A = only with a letter the reader marked as
alternative; C(n) = n letters corrected beyond both the preferred and marked alternatives; U = unread (no word assigned);
X = word with a slip (extra/missing letter), counted as corrected.
